videos.headline: Ohio State wins ugly over Northwestern
videos.description: Ohio State overcomes a slow start and bad conditions to take down Northwestern 21-7.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF Highlight (Ohio State wins ugly over Northwestern) 2022/11/05 ESHEET SOTFULL

videos.headline: Evan Hull makes a man miss for a Northwestern TD
videos.description: Evan Hull gives Northwestern the lead as he makes a man miss in the hole and speeds to the end zone for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Evan Hull makes a man miss for a Northwestern TD) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Northwestern fired up after 4th-down stop
videos.description: Northwestern's Xander Mueller stuffs Miyan Williams in the hole for a huge fourth-down stop.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Northwestern fired up after 4th-down stop) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Egbuka spins into the end zone to put Ohio State on the board
videos.description: Emeka Egbuka stays inbounds and spins into the end zone for a 15-yard Ohio State touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Egbuka spins into the end zone to put Ohio State on the board) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ohio State stands strong on fourth down
videos.description: Evan Hull is stuffed at the line of scrimmage on fourth down, giving Ohio State the ball back.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Ohio State stands strong on fourth down) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Miyan Williams breaks out snow angel celebration after TD
videos.description: Miyan Williams breaks multiple tackles and gets into the end zone, giving Ohio State the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Miyan Williams breaks out snow angel celebration after TD) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sullivan's Houdini act gives Northwestern a first down
videos.description: Northwestern quarterback Brendan Sullivan somehow avoids a sack and flings it to Cam Porter for a first down.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Sullivan's Houdini act gives Northwestern a first down) 2022/11/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Stroud's 44-yard run sets up the Williams TD
videos.description: C.J. Stroud keeps it on the option and gets down to the Northwestern 5-yard line. A couple plays later, Miyan Williams goes up the middle for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Stroud's 44-yard run sets up the Williams TD) 2022/11/05 ESHEET
